cards.title: Validate data types after cleaning

python show_dtypes.py
python assert_age_dtype.py
python check_object_dtypes.py
python check_date_dtype.py

cards.title: Review cleaning transformations applied
cards.when: When auditing what changes were made to the data during the cleaning process.
cards.cmds:
python compare_shapes.py
python list_columns.py
python head_sample.py
python describe_salary.py

cards.title: Check for outliers in cleaned data
cards.when: When verifying that outlier handling was effective during data cleaning.
cards.cmds:
python describe_price.py
python find_iqr_outliers.py
python count_range_outliers.py
python check_min_max_price.py

cards.title: Verify shell script syntax using shellcheck
cards.when: You modified a bash script and need to prove it parses without syntax errors before execution.
cards.cmds:
ls script.sh
shellcheck script.sh
which bash

cards.title: Validate JSON structure in shell environment
cards.when: You generated or modified a JSON config file in a shell workflow and must verify it is parseable.
cards.cmds:
ls config.json
python3 -m json.tool config.json
stat -c %s config.json

cards.title: Verify script execution exit code
cards.when: You ran a shell script as a test and need to confirm it completed successfully without errors.
cards.cmds:
bash ./test_script.sh
echo $?
tail -1 test_script.sh

cards.title: Validate shell script against shell standard
cards.when: You want to ensure a shell script complies with POSIX or bash standards to prevent unexpected behavior during execution.
cards.cmds:
which shellcheck
shellcheck --severity=error -s posix script.sh
shellcheck --severity=error -s posix script.sh | wc -l

cards.title: Rank quarterly features by impact and effort
cards.when: A small team needs to decide which features to build next quarter before planning starts.
cards.cmds:
printf "feature1,5,8
feature2,3,10
feature3,4,6
"
sort -t, -k3,3nr /tmp/features.csv
awk -F, '$3 > 5 {print $1}' /tmp/features.csv

cards.title: Identify dependencies between quarterly initiatives
cards.when: The team must understand which projects block others before setting the quarter plan.
cards.cmds:
printf "initA,initB
initB,
initC,initA
"
cut -d, -f1 /tmp/deps.txt | sort | uniq
awk -F, 'NF==1 {print $1}' /tmp/deps.txt

cards.title: Estimate team capacity for next quarter
cards.when: The small team needs to know how many person-hours are available before assigning work.
cards.cmds:
python3 -c "print(3 * 40 * 13)"
python3 -c "print(int(3 * 40 * 13 * 0.8))"
echo "Available hours: 1248"

cards.title: Generate prioritized roadmap markdown file
cards.when: The team needs a formatted roadmap document to share the quarterly plan with stakeholders.
cards.cmds:
printf "# Q3 Roadmap

## Priority 1
- Item: 
- Owner: 
- Due: 
"
echo "- Feature: auth-refactor | Owner: Alice | Due: Oct 15"
grep -c "Owner:" /tmp/roadmap.md

cards.title: Flag high-risk initiatives for review
cards.when: The team wants to identify which quarterly projects have the most technical uncertainty.
cards.cmds:
printf "api-v2,4
mobile-app,2
infra-upgrade,5
"
awk -F, '$2 >= 4 {print $1}' /tmp/risks.txt
awk -F, '$2 >= 4' /tmp/risks.txt | wc -l

cards.title: Document planning assumptions for the quarter
cards.when: The team needs to record the key assumptions made during quarterly prioritization for future reference.
cards.cmds:
echo "2024-Q3: Assume no team departures for 13 weeks"
echo "2024-Q3: Assume infrastructure budget remains at $50k"
cat /tmp/assumptions.log

cards.title: Verify shell script permissions are correct
cards.when: You need to ensure a shell script has execute permissions but does not have world-writable permissions that could allow injection.
cards.cmds:
stat -c %a script.sh
stat -c %a script.sh
echo "Permissions need to be set to 755"

cards.title: Define Svelte Design Tokens in Tailwind
cards.when: Starting a new Svelte project that needs consistent colors and spacing using CSS variables.
cards.cmds:
touch tailwind.config.cjs
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o ./src/app.css
test -f ./src/app.css

cards.title: Verify Contrast Ratios for Text Tokens
cards.when: Ensuring that foreground and background text colors meet accessibility standards.
cards.cmds:
grep -oE '#[0-9a-f]{6}' src/styles/tokens.css
npx axe http://localhost:5173
echo "0 violations expected"

cards.title: Standardize Spacing Units in Svelte CSS
cards.when: Cleaning up arbitrary pixel values to use a consistent spacing scale.
cards.cmds:
rg -n "\d+px" src/*.svelte
sed -i 's/16px/1rem/g' src/styles/global.css
rg -c "\d+px" src/*.svelte
echo "Target: 0"

cards.title: Audit Font Loading for Svelte Apps
cards.when: Ensuring custom fonts load efficiently without causing layout shifts.
cards.cmds:
grep -r "@font-face" src/
grep -r "font-display: swap" src/
npx lighthouse http://localhost:5173 --only-categories=performance
echo "Target CLS < 0.1"

cards.title: Run headless engine tests with fixed seeds
cards.when: You need to prove that specific game logic changes behave deterministically across multiple runs.
cards.cmds:
pytest -q
pytest -q
echo $?
ls tests/

cards.title: Identify sources of test flakiness via grep
cards.when: Headless tests pass and fail intermittently, suggesting hidden time or random dependencies.
cards.cmds:
grep -rniE "random\(|rand\(" src/
grep -rn "Date\.now|time\.time" src/
wc -l
head -n 5 src/game_logic.py

cards.title: Verify test exit codes for pass/fail proof
cards.when: You need to formally prove that the test suite fails before a fix and passes after.
cards.cmds:
pytest -q
echo $?
pytest -q
echo $?

cards.title: Check Go module dependency tidiness
cards.when: go.mod or go.sum files have been modified and must be verified.
cards.cmds:
bash -c 'go mod tidy'
git diff --exit-code go.mod go.sum
git diff go.mod go.sum

cards.title: Verify goroutine leak prevention in tests
cards.when: A Go program uses goroutines and must ensure none are leaked during tests.
cards.cmds:
cat worker.go
bash -c 'go test ./worker -race -count=1'
grep 'leaked goroutine' test_output.log

cards.title: Prove Go test fails on old code
cards.when: You need to demonstrate that a new test correctly identifies a previous bug.
cards.cmds:
git revert --no-commit HEAD~1
bash -c 'go test ./store -run TestQuery/empty_input -count=1'
git reset --hard HEAD

cards.title: Separate game logic from rendering for headless tests
cards.when: You modified game rules or physics and need to verify logic without a GPU window.
cards.cmds:
rg -n "game.loop|simulation.step" src/
mkdir -p tests/headless
python3 -m pytest tests/test_import_logic.py -v
ls -la tests/headless

cards.title: Validate edge cases for zero and huge delta time
cards.when: You are verifying game physics logic that might break with abnormal time step values.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/test_delta_time.py
pytest tests/test_delta_time.py -v
python3 scripts/check_zero_dt.py
python3 scripts/check_huge_dt.py

cards.title: Document non-testable aspects of game feel
cards.when: You have verified logic but need to specify what still requires human playtesting.
cards.cmds:
touch docs/manual_testing.md
printf 'Automated tests cover logic and physics deterministically.\n'
printf '- Jump responsiveness\n- Camera smoothing\n'
cat docs/manual_testing.md

cards.title: Reproduce guard false block with replay
cards.when: When a harmless command is blocked by the policy guard during daily review.
cards.cmds:
sampo replay --cmd "ls -la /tmp"
cat replay_output.log

cards.title: Check guard logs for frequent false blocks
cards.when: When multiple harmless commands are blocked during the day's review.
cards.cmds:
ls /scratch/guard_logs/
grep -c "rule:whitelist" /scratch/guard_logs/today.log

cards.title: Verify guard fix with history replay
cards.when: After updating a guard rule, verify it does not break allowed commands.
cards.cmds:
sampo replay --history /scratch/guard_logs/allowed.log
grep -c "blocked" replay_result.log

cards.title: Generate guard coverage report with sampo
cards.when: When needing to verify corpus coverage before final review.
cards.cmds:
sampo bench guard --mutate --coverage
cat coverage_report.txt

cards.title: Verify API endpoint returns JSON
cards.when: Testing that an API endpoint provides machine-readable data.
cards.cmds:
curl -s -H "Accept: application/json" http://localhost:8080/status
jq .status
test $? -eq 0

cards.title: Check API version compatibility
cards.when: Ensuring changes to an API do not break existing clients.
cards.cmds:
ls api/
grep -r "version" api/
git log --oneline -5

cards.title: Verify baseline font size in points
cards.when: Reviewing a print layout where the base text size must be exactly 12pt.
cards.cmds:
find ./build -name "*.pdf"
grep -r "font-size: 12pt" ./styles/
grep -r "font-size: 12pt" ./styles/ | wc -l

cards.title: Check leading value for body text
cards.when: Ensuring the line spacing for body copy is set to 1.5 times the font size.
cards.cmds:
grep -n "line-height" ./styles/print.css
grep "line-height: 1.5" ./styles/print.css
grep -c "line-height: 1.5" ./styles/print.css

cards.title: Verify WCAG AA contrast for mobile text
cards.when: Reviewing a mobile layout grid to ensure text meets minimum contrast standards.
cards.cmds:
grep -r 'color:' src/styles/mobile.css
echo 'Calculate contrast ratio manually or use a tool'
test 4.5 -lt 4.5 -o 4.5 -eq 4.5
test 3.0 -lt 3.0 -o 3.0 -eq 3.0

cards.title: Check touch target size on mobile grid
cards.when: Ensuring interactive elements on a mobile layout are large enough for touch.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 'min-height' src/styles/buttons.css
test 44 -ge 44
grep -n 'min-width' src/styles/buttons.css
test 44 -ge 44

cards.title: Audit color contrast in dark mode mobile
cards.when: Reviewing a mobile grid that supports dark mode themes for contrast issues.
cards.cmds:
grep 'background' src/themes/dark.css
grep 'color' src/themes/dark.css
echo 'Calculate ratio for #0f0f0f on #1a1a1a'
test 1.5 -ge 4.5

cards.title: Measure spacing between grid items on mobile
cards.when: Checking if the layout grid has sufficient whitespace between elements on small screens.
cards.cmds:
grep 'gap' src/layout/grid.css
sed -n 's/.*gap: \([0-9]*\)px.*/\1/p' src/layout/grid.css
test 16 -ge 16

cards.title: Verify font size legibility on mobile grid
cards.when: Ensuring base font sizes in the mobile layout grid are readable without zooming.
cards.cmds:
grep 'font-size' src/styles/root.css
sed -n 's/.*font-size: \([0-9]*\)px.*/\1/p' src/styles/root.css
test 16 -ge 16

cards.title: Inspect color contrast for secondary text
cards.when: Reviewing mobile layout grid elements that use muted or secondary text colors.
cards.cmds:
grep 'secondary' src/styles/colors.css
grep 'background' src/layout/section.css
echo 'Calculate ratio for #666666 on #ffffff'
test 5.9 -ge 4.5

python train.py --model net --epochs 5
mlflow runs list --experiment-id 1

cards.cmds:

python predict.py --input data.json
python log_prediction.py --result result.json

python log_ddp.py --rank 0

python log_es.py --final_val 0.02 --epoch 12

cards.title: Draft Postmortem Decision Memo Skeleton
cards.when: When starting a plan for a costly, irreversible engineering choice.
cards.cmds:
echo "Decision: Replace Postgres with ClickHouse by 2024-11-01?"
grep -r "storage limit" ./docs/architecture.md
touch postmortem_draft.md
echo "# Decision: Replace Postgres?"

cards.title: Define Evaluation Criteria Table Header
cards.when: When the decision question and constraints are defined.
cards.cmds:
echo "Criteria: Build Cost, Reverse Cost, Risk, Fit"
echo "| Option | Build Cost | Reverse Cost | Risk | Fit |"
tail -2 postmortem_draft.md
grep -c "| Option |" postmortem_draft.md

cards.title: Generate Option Rows for Comparison
cards.when: When at least three options including a baseline are identified.
cards.cmds:
echo "Postgres"
wc -l options.txt
echo "| Postgres | Low | High | Medium | High |"
echo "| ClickHouse | Medium | High | High | Low |"

cards.title: Record Final Decision and Revisit Trigger
cards.when: When the option with the best score is selected.
cards.cmds:
echo "**Choice:** ClickHouse because Fit is primary constraint."
echo "**Revisit:** If p95 latency exceeds 200ms."
grep -q "**Revisit:**" postmortem_draft.md
tail -3 postmortem_draft.md

cards.title: Validate Memo Structure with Grep
cards.when: When the memo draft is complete and ready for review.
cards.cmds:
grep -q "^# Decision:" postmortem_draft.md
grep -q "^Constraints:" postmortem_draft.md
grep -q "^Assumptions:" postmortem_draft.md
grep -q "^\*\*Revisit:" postmortem_draft.md

head -n 10 /var/log/app.log

du -sh /var/log/app.log.1
echo '5'

cards.when: Use this when reviewing JavaScript code for unhandled promise rejections.

ls *.js | grep .js
rg "catch.*\(\)\s*=>\s*\[\]" -g "*.js"

cards.title: Identify Generic Rethrows in TypeScript Code

ls *.ts | grep .ts
rg "throw new Error\(" -g "*.ts"

cards.title: Review Fallback Values in Go Code

ls *.go | grep .go
rg "if err != nil \{ return 0" -g "*.go"

cards.title: Plan grep patterns for high-throughput log search

file /var/log/app.log
grep 'ERROR' /var/log/app.log | wc -c

npm audit --audit-level=high
npx eslint . --plugin security

rg "process.env" -t js

cards.title: Verify HTTPS enforcement and session security

rg "secure: true" -t js

cards.title: Verify CI container environment variables

env

find tests/ -name '*security*'
python -m coverage report --include='security.py'

python -m coverage report

cards.title: Check if project already depends on module

pip list | grep json

wc -l security_report.md
head -5 security_report.md

cards.title: Search for hardcoded secrets in code

rg 'password' src/ --glob '!*test*'
rg -c 'password' src/ --glob '!*test*'

python3 --version

cards.title: Build modal list empty and error states
cards.when: Use when a modal list can have 0 items or a load error.

npx playwright test tests/modal-list-states.spec.ts

cards.title: Build modal form empty and error states
cards.when: Use when a modal form starts empty and must show submit failure errors.
cards.cmds:
touch src/components/ModalFormState.tsx
npx eslint src/components/ModalFormState.tsx

cards.title: Build inline field errors and empty state in modal
cards.when: Use when modal validation needs per-field errors and a no-data message.
cards.cmds:
touch src/components/ModalValidationStates.tsx
grep -c aria-invalid src/components/ProfileFormModal.tsx
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Build modal fetch empty and error states
cards.when: Use when modal content can load 0 records or fail the request.
cards.cmds:
touch src/components/ModalFetchState.tsx
npx playwright test tests/modal-fetch-states.spec.ts

cards.title: Build modal state machine for empty and error

touch src/components/ModalState.tsx
npx playwright test tests/modal-state.spec.ts
npx eslint src/components/ModalState.tsx

cards.title: Build accessible live region for empty and error

npx playwright test tests/modal-a11y.spec.ts

cards.title: Scope maintainer user guide from source tasks
cards.when: Use when starting a short user guide for maintainers and the required maintenance workflow is not yet written.
cards.cmds:
ls
rg 'npm run' .
touch docs/plan.md
wc -l docs/plan.md

cards.title: Turn maintainer ask into testable guide goals
cards.when: Use when a maintainer asks for a guide but the success state is vague.
cards.cmds:
rg 'setup' docs
touch docs/plan.md
wc -l docs/plan.md

cards.title: Trim user guide plan to maintainer needs
cards.when: Use when a guide outline covers end users but the reader is a maintainer.
cards.cmds:
ls docs
rg 'Install' docs/guide.md
grep -c '##' docs/plan.md

cards.title: Choose verification steps for guide plan
cards.when: Use when the guide will promise that a maintainer can finish a task.
cards.cmds:
touch docs/plan.md
rg 'make test' Makefile
rg 'make test' docs/plan.md

cards.title: Inspect repo before asking maintainer questions
cards.when: Use when a user guide request needs clarification but the repo may already answer it.
cards.cmds:
ls
rg 'schema' docs
wc -l docs/questions.md

cards.title: Plan concise handoff for guide writer
cards.when: Use when another agent will write the user guide and needs a short plan.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p docs
touch docs/handoff.md
rg 'maintenance' docs
python3 -c 'open("docs/handoff.md","w").write("scope: key rotation\nlimits: no secrets\nlimits: no UI\ntask: rotation\n")'
wc -l docs/handoff.md

cards.title: Add aria-label for icon-only button buttons
cards.when: Creating a button that displays only an icon and has no visible text label
cards.cmds:
touch aria-btn.html
sed -i '1i <button aria-label="Close dialog"><svg>...</svg></button>' aria-btn.html
grep -c 'aria-label' aria-btn.html
npx eslint --ext .html aria-btn.html
npx playwright test -g "aria label test"

cards.title: Set explicit width and height for SVG icons
cards.when: Embedding an SVG icon inside a button that must be scaled correctly for accessibility
cards.cmds: touch icon.svg sed -i '1i ' icon.svg touch svg-btn.html sed -i '1i ' svg-btn.html grep -c 'width="24"' svg-btn.html npx playwright test -g "svg size check"

cards.title: Ensure button has unique accessible name in context
cards.when: Building a list of buttons where multiple share the same visible label
cards.cmds:
touch dup.html
sed -i '1i <form><button type="submit">Submit</button><button type="button">Submit</button></form>' dup.html
sed -i 's/<button type="submit">Submit</button>/<button type="submit" aria-labelledby="sub1">Submit</button>/' dup.html
sed -i 's/<button type="button">Submit</button>/<button type="button" aria-labelledby="sub2">Submit</button>/' dup.html
npx axe-core dup.html
grep -c 'aria-labelledby' dup.html

cards.title: Verify SQL payload execution in scratch database
cards.when: When executing a generated SQL query against a sandboxed database to confirm syntax and logic.
cards.cmds:
sqlite3 :memory: ".schema users"
sqlite3 scratch.db ".read query.sql"
echo $?

cards.title: Detect SQL injection patterns in bot logs
cards.when: When reviewing automated bot interaction logs for potential SQL injection attempts.
cards.cmds:
rg -i "select|union|drop" logs/bot_activity.log
rg -i "select|union|drop" logs/bot_activity.log | wc -l
rg -i "select|union|drop" logs/bot_activity.log | head -n 1

cards.title: Validate parameterized query usage in SQL code
cards.when: When auditing SQL code generated by an automated bot to ensure parameterization.
cards.cmds:
find . -name "*.sql" -type f
grep -r "\+\s*\$" --include="*.sql" .
grep -r "?" --include="*.sql" .

cards.title: Monitor SQL query performance from bot execution
cards.when: When checking if automated SQL queries execute within performance thresholds.
cards.cmds:
sqlite3 scratch.db ".timing on" ".read query.sql"
tail -n 1
awk 'BEGIN { exit (100 < 50) ? 0 : 1 }'

cards.title: Reproduce CLI crash with exact arguments
cards.when: A command-line tool crashes with a traceback or unexpected exit code.
cards.cmds:
bash
echo
cat

cards.title: Verify exit code and stderr message
cards.when: Fixing a CLI tool that crashes on bad input.
cards.cmds:
python
echo
grep
wc

cards.title: Handle short IDs and case variations
cards.when: CLI rejects natural argument shapes like short IDs.
cards.cmds:
bash
bash
echo
grep

cards.title: Act on exactly the named items
cards.when: CLI acts on more items than requested.
cards.cmds:
bash
grep
rg

cards.title: Process multiple items with error handling
cards.when: CLI handles multiple items at once.
cards.cmds:
bash
grep
echo

cards.title: Maintain JSON output consistency
cards.when: CLI supports --json flag for structured output and error reporting.
cards.cmds:
bash mytool delete t-5 --json
jq .id
jq .errors
cat output.json

cards.title: Verify toast enter animation duration and easing
cards.when: When the toast uses an AnimatedContainer or Tween and you must prove the timing meets the 200ms spec
cards.cmds:
find test -name "*toast*test.dart"
flutter test test/widgets/toast_widget_test.dart --plain-name "verify enter animation duration"
grep -i "elapsed time" test_output.txt
grep -n "Duration(milliseconds: 200)" lib/widgets/toast.dart

cards.title: Verify toast exit animation opacity reaches zero
cards.when: When the toast fades out and you need to confirm the final opacity value is 0.0
cards.cmds:
rg -l "WidgetTester" test/ | head -1
flutter test test/widgets/toast_exit_test.dart
grep -o "Opacity(opacity: [0-9.]*" test_output.txt | tail -1
echo "Opacity(opacity: 0.0)" | grep -c "0.0"

cards.title: Verify toast slide-in transform translation vector
cards.when: When the toast slides up from the bottom and you must verify the start offset is -50px
cards.cmds:
ls test/widgets/toast_transform_test.dart
flutter test test/widgets/toast_transform_test.dart
grep -o "translation: Offset(0.0, -[0-9.]*\))" test_output.txt
echo "50.0" | awk '{if ($1 == 50.0) print "MATCH"}'

cards.title: Verify toast animation curve is material standard
cards.when: When the motion uses a Curve and you must ensure it matches the Material standard decelerate curve
cards.cmds:
grep -n "Curve" lib/widgets/toast.dart
flutter test test/widgets/toast_curve_test.dart
grep -c "Curves.easeOut" lib/widgets/toast.dart
grep -c "Curves.linear" lib/widgets/toast.dart

cards.title: Verify toast animation frame rate stability
cards.when: When the toast animation runs and you need to ensure no dropped frames affect the 60fps target
cards.cmds:
flutter test integration/toast_perf_test.dart
grep -o "frame duration: [0-9.]*ms" test_output.txt
grep -c "frame duration: 1[7-9].*ms" test_output.txt
tail -1 test_output.txt

cards.title: Verify toast interruption behavior with overlapping animations
cards.when: When a new toast appears while the previous one is still animating out
cards.cmds:
touch test/widgets/toast_overlap_test.dart
flutter test test/widgets/toast_overlap_test.dart
grep -i "isAnimating" test_output.txt | wc -l
grep -c "true" test_output.txt

cards.title: Audit mobile wireframe text size hierarchy against 16px base
cards.when: The plan stage requires verifying that body text is 16px and headers are larger.
cards.cmds:
grep "font-size" wireframe/mobile.css
grep -c "font-size: 16px" wireframe/mobile.css
grep -E "font-size: [0-9]px" wireframe/mobile.css | grep -v "16px"
grep -E "font-size: [2-9]\d?px" wireframe/mobile.css | head -n 1

cards.title: Verify mobile layout margin consistency in wireframe assets
cards.when: The plan stage requires checking that left and right margins are exactly 16px on mobile.
cards.cmds:
grep -r margin-left wireframe/mobile.css
grep -c "margin-left: 16px" wireframe/mobile.css
grep -v "margin-left: 16px" wireframe/mobile.css
grep -c margin-left wireframe/mobile.css

cards.title: Validate concurrent logic with manual inspection
cards.when: Reviewing code for obvious concurrency mistakes
cards.cmds:
cat script.pl
rg 'fork' script.pl
rg 'lock' script.pl

cards.title: Run Perl concurrency tests with prove
cards.when: Verifying that concurrent code passes its test suite
cards.cmds:
perl -wc script.pl
perl -Ilib -MTest::Harness -e 'runtests(@ARGV)' t/
perl -Ilib -MTest::Harness -e 'runtests(@ARGV)' --severity 4 script.pl

cards.title: Verify race condition handling in tests
cards.when: Confirming that specific concurrency edge cases are tested
cards.cmds:
rg -i 'concurrent|race|thread' t/
perl -Ilib -MTest::Harness -e 'runtests(@ARGV)' -v t/concurrency.t
ls t/

cards.title: Check Perl script for concurrency warnings
cards.when: Detecting potential issues in concurrent Perl code
cards.cmds:
perl -w -wc script.pl
perl -Ilib -MTest::Harness -e 'runtests(@ARGV)' --severity 2 script.pl
wc -l script.pl

cards.title: Verify test coverage for concurrent modules
cards.when: Ensuring concurrent modules have sufficient test coverage
cards.cmds:
ls t/
perl -Ilib -MTest::Harness -e 'runtests(@ARGV)' -lr t/
ls lib/

cards.title: Verify Perl concurrency with specific test case
cards.when: Testing a specific known concurrency bug scenario
cards.cmds:
find t -name 'bug*' -type f
perl -Ilib -MTest::Harness -e 'runtests(@ARGV)' -v t/bug_race.t
cat t/bug_race.t

cards.title: Record log reliability decision with sampo command
cards.when: Finalizing the choice and saving the rationale to the system.
cards.cmds:
sampo decide "Use Vector for logs" --why "Low reverse cost" --rejected "Fluentd, Do Nothing"
sampo decide "Use Vector for logs" --revisit "2024-06-01"
sampo show "Use Vector for logs"

cards.title: Check recent C++ changes with git diff
cards.when: You need to see what C++ code changed in the current project.
cards.cmds:
cd /home/dev/project
git diff --name-only -- '*.cpp' '*.hpp'
git diff HEAD -- src/main.cpp
git diff --numstat

cards.title: Verify C++ headers with include guards
cards.when: You need to ensure header files prevent multiple inclusion errors.
cards.cmds:
find . -name '*.hpp' -type f
head -10 include/utils.hpp
grep -L '#pragma once' include/*.hpp
head -5 include/utils.hpp

cards.title: Check for raw new and delete usage
cards.when: You need to identify unsafe memory management in C++ code.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 'new ' src/*.cpp
grep -n 'delete ' src/*.cpp
grep -n 'unique_ptr' src/*.cpp

cards.title: Detect missing null checks for pointers
cards.when: You need to find pointer dereferences without null safety checks.
cards.cmds:
grep -n '->' src/*.cpp
grep -n 'if.*==.*nullptr' src/*.cpp
sed -n '10,20p' src/main.cpp

cards.title: Run clang-tidy on modified C++ files
cards.when: You need static analysis to find memory safety issues in C++ code.
cards.cmds:
cd /home/dev/project
git diff --name-only -- '*.cpp' '*.hpp'
clang --analyze -- -fsyntax-only -Wall -Wextra src/main.cpp
clang --analyze -- -fsyntax-only -Wall -Wextra -Xclang -analyzer-checker=core.cplusplus.NewDeleteLeaks src/main.cpp

cards.title: Cross-reference roadmap items with deployed versions
cards.when: Ensuring all roadmap items for the quarter are marked as deployed in the release notes.
cards.cmds:
cat /docs/roadmap/q3-2024.md
grep -E '^\s*- \[x\]' /docs/roadmap/q3-2024.md | cut -d ' ' -f 2
cat /docs/releases/release-notes.md
rg -q 'FEATURE-123' /docs/releases/release-notes.md
echo "Missing features logged to stderr"

cards.title: Check network ACLs for open ports
cards.when: Verifying that no unauthorized open ports exist in the network configuration for the quarter.
cards.cmds:
find . -name 'network-*.tf' -o -name 'acl-*.yaml'
grep -A 5 'ingress' ./*.tf | grep -E 'protocol|port_range'
grep -E 'protocol = "\-1"|port_range = "\-1/-1"'
wc -l
ls ./*.tf | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -f /dev/stdin

cards.title: Verify empty state fade-in duration
cards.when: The component renders when data is missing and needs a specific animation time.
cards.cmds:
npx jest --testPathPattern=EmptyState
grep "animation-duration" src/styles/empty-state.css
echo "Expected: 300ms"
tail -5 /dev/null

cards.title: Check empty state accessibility contrast
cards.when: The empty state text must meet WCAG AA standards for visibility.
cards.cmds:
npx axe http://localhost:3000/empty
grep "contrast" axe-report.json
echo "Min ratio: 4.5"
jq '.violations' axe-report.json

cards.title: Verify empty state screen reader labels
cards.when: The component must be announced correctly by assistive technologies.
cards.cmds:
grep "aria-label" src/components/EmptyState.tsx
cat src/components/EmptyState.tsx | head -20
npx jest --testPathPattern=EmptyState.a11y
echo "Check aria usage"

cards.title: Test empty state motion prefers-reduced
cards.when: Users with motion sensitivity settings must see a static state.
cards.cmds:
grep "prefers-reduced-motion" src/styles/empty-state.css
grep "animation: none" src/styles/empty-state.css
npx jest --testPathPattern=motion
echo "Expect 0 active"

cards.title: Verify empty state render threshold time
cards.when: The component must appear within a specific time limit.
cards.cmds:
npx jest --testPathPattern=perf
grep "renderTime" test-results.json
echo "Limit: 100ms"
cat test-results.json | jq '.status'

cards.title: Check empty state icon dimensions
cards.when: The placeholder icon must meet minimum touch target size.
cards.cmds:
grep "width" src/assets/empty-icon.svg
echo "Min: 24px"
npm run lint
ls src/assets/empty-icon.svg

cards.title: Verify secret rotation logs for quarter
cards.when: Checking if secrets were rotated during the quarter as required by the review stage.
cards.cmds:
ls -l /var/log/secrets/rotation.log
grep '2024-01\|2024-02\|2024-03' /var/log/secrets/rotation.log
wc -l
tail -n 1
test 5 -ge 4

cards.title: Validate CI/CD pipeline security configs
cards.when: Reviewing pipeline files to ensure they meet cloud security standards for the quarter.
cards.cmds:
find . -name '.gitlab-ci.yml' -o -name 'Jenkinsfile' -o -name '*.pipeline.yml'
grep -rEi 'password|secret|token' . --include='*.yml' --include='*.yaml' --include='Jenkinsfile'
grep -v '\${'
wc -l
echo 'Security violation found'
